item.title: Bomb Cyclone Hernando Whipped Up Massive Waves in New Jersey
item.description: Bomb Cyclone Hernando was a force of nature. It put hundreds of thousands in the dark, but also brought waves. Where you find waves, you often find Ben Gravy.

item.title: Two Hikers, 19 and 20, Found Dead in Welsh Mountain Range
item.description: The bodies of two hikers have been found in the Eryri mountain range, colloquially known as Snowdonia.

item.title: Skiers Run For Cover During ‘Controlled’ Avalanche at Russian Resort
item.description: Guests looked on in awe as a massive plume of snow engulfed a Russian ski resort this week, as seen in a video making the rounds on social media.

item.title: This Surfer Is Working on a Documentary After Near-Death Experience With Great White Shark
item.description: A near-death-experience with a great white inspired former pro surfer Brett Burcher to make a documentary examining the fear and reality of shark interactions.

item.title: Chris Hemsworth Describes Surfing in Byron Bay During Rash of Shark Attacks
item.description: In a recent episode of Smartless, Chris Hemsworth shared a story about his sketchy experience surfing in Byron Bay amidst a rash of shark attacks.

item.title: Hunter Jones Scored Los Angeles Surf at Its Best
item.description: The surf in L.A. is good sometimes, but rarely is it THIS good. Hunter Jones knows how rare it is, so he put himself in the right place at the right time.

item.title: Satellite Images Show Dramatic Sierra Nevada Transformation From February Storm
item.description: California's snowpack at the beginning of the new year was only slightly below average, sitting at 93 percent of its historical average on January 6.

item.title: Riding an Alaia Backhand at Double-Overhead Supertubes Looks Nearly Impossible
item.description: The alaia is an ancient piece of surf craft that is pretty much impossible to ride. But surfers like Remi Peterson can take them at out firing J-Bay.

item.title: The ISA Is Playing With Fire, But Pro Surfers Will Learn to Live With New Olympic Qualification
item.description: Championship Tour surfers will learn the new Olympic qualification works in their favor, but the ISA needs to be careful about souring relations with the WSL.

item.title: Avalanche Buries Three French Skiers in Terrifying Video
item.description: After heavy snowfall in the Alps led to avalanche warnings, resort closures, and deaths, a video shows three French skiers being engulfed in snow.
